clips.speaker: Jinsheng Jing
clips.title: 申万宏源蒋静：当前美债收益率4.5%是买入良机

subtitles.en: One thing is that I think from the short-term rate perspective, as I expect, there will be only like zero or at one time the most rate hike for the fact this year.
subtitles.zh: 从短期利率角度看，我预计今年美联储最多加息一次，甚至不加息。

subtitles.en: And with this breaking news, I think the pressure has go down to only zero times rate hike. So from the short-term rate point of view, we don't see there is a much pressure going up.
subtitles.zh: 加上这一突发消息，我认为加息压力已降至零。所以从短期利率角度看，我们看不到上行压力。

subtitles.en: And also from the risk of premium perspective, because this year we don't see there is a lot of pressure on more US deficit, US physical deficit going up.
subtitles.zh: 从风险溢价角度看，今年我们看不到美国赤字大幅增加的压力。

subtitles.en: And also, I think when Kevin Worsh actually go on the Fed board, he would not implement the so-called balance sheet reduction very quickly, because that is more like a systematic work to do.
subtitles.zh: 而且，我认为当沃什进入美联储董事会后，他不会很快实施所谓的缩表，因为这更像是一项系统性工作。

subtitles.en: So from the premium side, I think the risk is controllable. So at this current level, like 4.5 US Treasuries, I think the rate is high, and the duration rate risk is generally controllable.
subtitles.zh: 所以从溢价角度看，风险可控。在当前4.5%的水平，我认为收益率较高，久期风险总体可控。

subtitles.en: So that's what I think that is a good price to buy.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这是一个好的买入价格。

clips.speaker_context: Head of global asset allocation research and chief analyst at SWS Research, a subsidiary of Shenhua Hongyuan

clips.speaker: Jinsheng Jing
clips.title: 申万宏源蒋静：关注中国国产算力与AI芯片机会

subtitles.en: I think the AI trade is generally going upward, doing the big trend, one for sure.
subtitles.zh: 我认为AI交易总体呈上升趋势，大趋势是确定的。

subtitles.en: And we have to recommend, or we have to point it out, I think for the second half of the year, we also need to pay more attention to the Chinese computing power capex trend.
subtitles.zh: 我们必须指出，下半年我们还需要更多关注中国算力资本开支趋势。

subtitles.en: We can see that with the combination, with DeepSeq and the Huawei shapes, this might, I would say, acknowledge the enthusiasm for the packers of the Chinese domestic computing power.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到，结合DeepSeq和华为的形态，这可能会激发对中国国产算力封装的热情。

subtitles.en: So in terms of the market, that we can also find more opportunities on this side, not only just those opportunities driven by the big names in the US market.
subtitles.zh: 所以在市场方面，我们也能在这一侧找到更多机会，而不仅仅是美国市场大公司驱动的机会。

subtitles.en: Tell us some of those names. What stands out here? What should foreign investors be looking at in as far as the Chinese domestic markets are concerned?
subtitles.zh: 请告诉我们一些具体的公司。哪些比较突出？外国投资者在中国国内市场应该关注什么？

subtitles.en: Like Han Wuji, like those chips are actually driven by the domestic capex, like Han Wuji, and some also from the Chinese market, the Hong Kong market.
subtitles.zh: 比如寒武纪，这些芯片实际上是由国内资本开支驱动的，还有来自中国内地市场和香港市场的一些新公司。

clips.speaker: Robert Pape
clips.title: 芝加哥大学政治学教授Robert Pape：美军撤军是中东局势走向的关键指标
title_lines: 芝加哥大学政治学教授Robert Pape
美军撤军是中东局势走向

subtitles.en: Oh, absolutely. I mean, if it turns out that President Trump doesn't just end the blockade, but withdraws 50, 70% of the naval assets that have been moved to the region, that's a huge indicator.
subtitles.zh: 哦，绝对是的。我的意思是，如果特朗普总统不仅解除封锁，还撤出部署到该地区50%到70%的海军资产，那将是一个巨大的指标。

subtitles.en: If we withdraw, say, 20,000 or 10,000 troops that we have put in since the war, that would really be a big indicator. So, for example, if those airborne troops were to be taken out of theater, that would be an indicator.
subtitles.zh: 如果我们撤出战后部署的2万或1万军队，那将是一个很大的指标。例如，如果那些空降部队被撤出战区，那将是一个指标。

subtitles.en: If the Marines would be physically lifted back to their bases in Asia and also in California, that would be a major indicator, but so far President Trump has said he's going to do that.
subtitles.zh: 如果海军陆战队被实际运回他们在亚洲和加利福尼亚的基地，那将是一个主要指标，但到目前为止，特朗普总统已经表示他会这样做。

subtitles.en: So in terms of this theory, the escalation trap, where do you think things are and where things stand now? We're in what I would call the middle game.
subtitles.zh: 那么根据这个理论，升级陷阱，你认为现在情况如何？我们正处于我所说的中局阶段。

clips.speaker_context: Professor of Political Science, University of Chicago
